Keywords: trend, time-series, line, growth, timeline, progress
When to Use: Data has a time axis; user needs to observe rise/fall trends
When NOT to Use: Fewer than 4 data points; more than 6 series; no time dimension exists
Color Guidance: Primary: #0080FF. Multiple series: distinct colors + distinct line styles.
Accessibility Notes: Differentiate series by line style (solid/dashed/dotted) not color alone.
A11y Fallback: Dashed/dotted lines per series; togglable data table

When to Use: Comparing discrete categories by magnitude; ranking or ordering is the core insight
When NOT to Use: Categories > 15 (use table); data has time dimension (use line)
Color Guidance: Each bar: distinct color. Always sort descending by value
Accessibility Notes: Value labels on each bar by default. Sort control for user reordering.
A11y Fallback: Value labels always visible; provide CSV export

Keywords: part-to-whole, pie, donut, percentage, proportion, share
When to Use: ≤5 categories; emphasis on visual proportion over exact values
Data Volume Threshold: Max 6 slices; beyond that switch to stacked bar 100%
Color Guidance: 5–6 max colors. Largest slice at 12 o'clock. Always label slices with %
Accessibility Notes: Pie charts fail WCAG for colorblind users. Slices rely on color alone.
A11y Fallback: Must provide stacked bar alternative + percentage data table

Keywords: funnel, flow, conversion, drop-off, pipeline, stages
When to Use: Sequential multi-stage process; showing conversion or drop-off rates
When NOT to Use: Stages aren't sequential; values don't decrease monotonically
Data Volume Threshold: 3–8 stages optimal; beyond 8 stages group minor steps into 'Other'
Color Guidance: Stages: single color gradient. Show conversion % between each stage.
Accessibility Notes: Explicit conversion % as text per stage. Stage labels always visible.
A11y Fallback: Provide linear list view with stage name + count + drop-off %

Keywords: performance, target, kpi, gauge, goal, threshold, progress
When to Use: Single KPI measured against a defined target or threshold
When NOT to Use: No target or benchmark exists; comparing multiple KPIs at once
Data Volume Threshold: Single metric per gauge; for 3+ KPIs use bullet chart grid
Color Guidance: Performance: Red → Yellow → Green gradient. Target: marker line.
Accessibility Notes: Always show numerical value + % of target as text beside chart.
A11y Fallback: Numerical value + % of target shown as visible text

Keywords: correlation, distribution, scatter, relationship, pattern, cluster
When to Use: Exploring relationship between two continuous variables; identifying clusters
When NOT to Use: Variables are categorical (use grouped bar); fewer than 20 points
Color Guidance: Color axis: gradient (blue → red). Bubble size: relative to 3rd variable.
Accessibility Notes: Provide data table alternative. Combine color + shape distinction.
A11y Fallback: Data table with correlation coefficient; shape markers per group

Keywords: heatmap, heat-map, intensity, density, matrix, calendar
When to Use: Showing intensity/density across a 2D grid; time-based patterns
When NOT to Use: Fewer than 20 cells (use bar); user needs to read exact values
Data Volume Threshold: Up to 10000 cells efficiently; calendar heatmap: 365 cells max
Color Guidance: Gradient: Cool (blue) to Hot (red). Always include numeric color legend
Accessibility Notes: Pattern overlay for colorblind users. Numerical value on hover.
A11y Fallback: Numerical overlay on hover; downloadable grid table

Keywords: radar, spider, multi-variable, attributes, dimensions, comparison
When to Use: Comparing multiple entities across the same fixed set of attributes
Color Guidance: Single dataset: #0080FF at 20% fill. Multiple: distinct hues with 30% fill.
Accessibility Notes: Limit axes to 5–8. Always provide grouped bar chart alternative.
A11y Fallback: Grouped bar chart as mandatory alternative; include raw data table
